title: Verify E170 range owner Load and Undo
changes: Check failed range dataset replacement and slot Load/Undo with an isolated E170 dataset copy and an active bounded-range owner.
validation: Windows GNU build bounded-range-e170-lifecycle-build-awvwepf1 and Wine bounded-range-e170-lifecycle-wine-p55pua3g pass. Missing and coherently modified range files are rejected without changing the active owner or complete state; slot Load and Undo restore exact states and retain the owner. All 88 bytes are served with altered raw source after Undo and by a fresh owner after restoration. Inputs protected, synthetic slots and scratch removed, Wine drained.
limitations: This uses the direct slot API and a synthetic machine; GUI, Fast, backup restoration, restart and other resource lifecycles are not tested. Other range readers and broader regressions remain open; Linux, USA, native Windows and performance are deferred.
